/* selectMasterMpStBuyerMarginStatsList */ SELECT MAX((SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND TYPE = 'C001' AND CODE = MIS.KEP_DEPT)) AS KEP_DEPT_NM , MAX(DECODE('Y','N','X',( SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=KEP.BUYER))) AS BUYER_NM , ROUND(SUM(NE_ITEM_AMT-NE_AGENT_AMT)/'100000',0) AS NE_ITEM_AMT , ROUND(SUM(NO_AMT)/'100000',0) AS NO_AMT , ROUND(SUM(DECODE(SUBSTR(KEP.YYYYMM,5,2),'01',NE_ITEM_AMT-NE_AGENT_AMT,0))/'100000',0) AS NE_ITEM_AMT01 , ROUND(SUM(DECODE(SUBSTR(KEP.YYYYMM,5,2),'01',NO_AMT,0))/'100000',0) AS NO_AMT01 , ROUND(SUM(DECODE(SUBSTR(KEP.YYYYMM,5,2),'02',NE_ITEM_AMT-NE_AGENT_AMT,0))/'100000',0) AS NE_ITEM_AMT02 , ROUND(SUM(DECODE(SUBSTR(KEP.YYYYMM,5,2),'02',NO_AMT,0))/'100000',0) AS NO_AMT02 , ROUND(SUM(DECODE(SUBSTR(KEP.YYYYMM,5,2),'03',NE_ITEM_AMT-NE_AGENT_AMT,0))/'100000',0) AS NE_ITEM_AMT03 , ROUND(SUM(DECODE(SUBSTR(KEP.YYYYMM,5,2),'03',NO_AMT,0))/'100000',0) AS NO_AMT03 , ROUND(SUM(DECODE(SUBSTR(KEP.YYYYMM,5,2),'04',NE_ITEM_AMT-NE_AGENT_AMT,0))/'100000',0) AS NE_ITEM_AMT04 , ROUND(SUM(DECODE(SUBSTR(KEP.YYYYMM,5,2),'04',NO_AMT,0))/'100000',0) AS NO_AMT04 , ROUND(SUM(DECODE(SUBSTR(KEP.YYYYMM,5,2),'05',NE_ITEM_AMT-NE_AGENT_AMT,0))/'100000',0) AS NE_ITEM_AMT05 , ROUND(SUM(DECODE(SUBSTR(KEP.YYYYMM,5,2),'05',NO_AMT,0))/'100000',0) AS NO_AMT05 , ROUND(SUM(DECODE(SUBSTR(KEP.YYYYMM,5,2),'06',NE_ITEM_AMT-NE_AGENT_AMT,0))/'100000',0) AS NE_ITEM_AMT06 , ROUND(SUM(DECODE(SUBSTR(KEP.YYYYMM,5,2),'06',NO_AMT,0))/'100000',0) AS NO_AMT06 , ROUND(SUM(DECODE(SUBSTR(KEP.YYYYMM,5,2),'07',NE_ITEM_AMT-NE_AGENT_AMT,0))/'100000',0) AS NE_ITEM_AMT07 , ROUND(SUM(DECODE(SUBSTR(KEP.YYYYMM,5,2),'07',NO_AMT,0))/'100000',0) AS NO_AMT07 , ROUND(SUM(DECODE(SUBSTR(KEP.YYYYMM,5,2),'08',NE_ITEM_AMT-NE_AGENT_AMT,0))/'100000',0) AS NE_ITEM_AMT08 , ROUND(SUM(DECODE(SUBSTR(KEP.YYYYMM,5,2),'08',NO_AMT,0))/'100000',0) AS NO_AMT08 , ROUND(SUM(DECODE(SUBSTR(KEP.YYYYMM,5,2),'09',NE_ITEM_AMT-NE_AGENT_AMT,0))/'100000',0) AS NE_ITEM_AMT09 , ROUND(SUM(DECODE(SUBSTR(KEP.YYYYMM,5,2),'09',NO_AMT,0))/'100000',0) AS NO_AMT09 , ROUND(SUM(DECODE(SUBSTR(KEP.YYYYMM,5,2),'10',NE_ITEM_AMT-NE_AGENT_AMT,0))/'100000',0) AS NE_ITEM_AMT10 , ROUND(SUM(DECODE(SUBSTR(KEP.YYYYMM,5,2),'10',NO_AMT,0))/'100000',0) AS NO_AMT10 , ROUND(SUM(DECODE(SUBSTR(KEP.YYYYMM,5,2),'11',NE_ITEM_AMT-NE_AGENT_AMT,0))/'100000',0) AS NE_ITEM_AMT11 , ROUND(SUM(DECODE(SUBSTR(KEP.YYYYMM,5,2),'11',NO_AMT,0))/'100000',0) AS NO_AMT11 , ROUND(SUM(DECODE(SUBSTR(KEP.YYYYMM,5,2),'12',NE_ITEM_AMT-NE_AGENT_AMT,0))/'100000',0) AS NE_ITEM_AMT12 , ROUND(SUM(DECODE(SUBSTR(KEP.YYYYMM,5,2),'12',NO_AMT,0))/'100000',0) AS NO_AMT12 , DECODE('Y','N','X',KEP.BUYER) AS BUYER , Case MIS.KEP_DEPT when '048' then '1' when '048' then '1' when '042' then '2' when '017' then '3' when '009' then '4' when '008' then '5' when '043' then '6' end as ORDER_DEPT FROM KEP_BUYER_MARGIN KEP, (SELECT BUYER,MIN(KEP_DEPT) AS KEP_DEPT FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG WHERE YEAR = #{st_year} AND STATUS = 'C' GROUP BY BUYER) MIS WHERE 1=1 AND KEP.BUYER != 'KRKEPB0004'
AND KEP.YYYYMM LIKE #{st_year}||'%'
AND MIS.KEP_DEPT IN (#{st_user_dept} ,'*')
AND KEP.BUYER = MIS.BUYER GROUP BY MIS.KEP_DEPT , DECODE('Y','N','X',KEP.BUYER) ORDER BY ORDER_DEPT,2
